directions.risks: 1) Bureaucratic drift: if any implementer nudges secondary toward saturated #006C35 flat fills or pairs it with pure white, it collapses into ministry branding — enforce the ivory base, the banded/textured treatment, and the desaturated-deep hexes exactly. 2) Appetite hazard: green touching food backdrops suppresses appetite; the ban on emerald behind photos is load-bearing, and the pistachio wash must stay pale and yellow-leaning. 3) Night-mode gravity: the malachite night is seductive to build and could quietly become the default, reproducing the rejected dark-luxury identity — day must ship as default with night behind the toggle. 4) Gold creep: saffron-bronze is rationed to prices/CTAs/one glint per viewport; add borders or foil textures in it and the design regresses to the Pikbest template economy the founder already rejected.

scores.direction_name: Khuyūt — خيوط (Sadu Threads on Morning Wool)
scores.note: Sadu done like JAX streetwear, not souvenir — the 'سمّ' CTA and Najdi microcopy alone get screenshotted; proudly ours, bright enough for the ALF-canon feed, and the Layali night mode covers the 8PM reality.
Boulevard neon is genuinely loved but this reads like Riyadh Season merch, not a cafe — it will feel dated the moment the season rebrands, and a black menu at a 1PM terrace is a real annoyance.

scores.direction_name: PISTACHIO HALA — يا هلا (Sunlit Pistachio & Sour Cherry)
scores.note: This is literally the matcha-tok aesthetic Saudi Gen-Z queues and posts right now — instant mass appeal, story-ready 4:5 cards — but it could be Seoul or LA; loved, not talked about, and it dates with the pistachio wave.
Elegant giga-project prestige, but Riyadh is drowning in greige-minimal cafes — mainstream eyes read 'another beige menu, Royal Commission energy'; admired, never screenshotted.

scores.direction_name: MALACHITE MAJLIS — Ivory by Day, Emerald by Night
scores.note: Green is a cultural tightrope: before anyone sees 'malachite jewelry' they see ministry letterhead or a Starbucks clone — the concept is clever but one hex-nudge from National Day campaign cringe.

judgments.top_pick: Khuyūt — خيوط (Sadu Threads on Morning Wool)
judgments.rationale: For the 18-40 Riyadh/Jeddah crowd, the winning formula is 'ours + new + bright + shareable', and Khuyūt is the only direction that hits all four. Sadu is having a genuine cultural moment (Founding Day fits, UNESCO listing, Boulevard merch, JAX exhibitions) and every Saudi reads it instantly as grandmother-heritage — but here it structures a modern Swiss layout instead of decorating a souvenir, which is exactly the code-switch this generation celebrates and reposts. The sunlit cream ground matches the light-cafe aesthetic people actually photograph (nobody posts a dark menu at ALF at 2PM), the huge Kufi headers flatter Arabic-first pride, and the dialect microcopy ('وش تشرب اليوم؟', 'سمّ', 'تكرم عينك') is the detail that gets screenshotted with a 'يجننن' caption — warmth no imported template can fake. Pistachio Hala scores nearly as high on pure mass appeal because it IS the current matcha/pistachio feed aesthetic, but that's precisely its weakness: it's everyone's aesthetic, globally generic, and tied to a drink trend with a shelf life. SAHRA borrows Boulevard's glow but feels like festival collateral rather than a cafe identity and fights the sun. SHUROUQ is tasteful wallpaper in a city saturated with beige minimalism. Malachite is the boldest idea but green's gravitational pull toward government/Starbucks readings makes it the riskiest bet for mainstream love. Khuyūt is the one people would tag the cafe over: 'شفتوا المنيو؟ سدو بس مودرن'.
grafts: From PISTACHIO HALA: the 4:5 Instagram-story-ratio featured cards with the Arabic name overlaid — make Khuyūt's screenshot-readiness literal by framing signature items as ready-made story assets.
From SAHRA: the 'توقيع الموسم' limited-drop card with countdown chip — drop-culture urgency that Riyadh Season trained users on, executed in Khuyūt's crimson thread instead of neon magenta.
From PISTACHIO HALA: lean the pistachio wash harder for matcha/pistachio drinks specifically — ride the live drink trend inside Khuyūt's wash system without rebranding around it.
From SHUROUQ: the museum-caption Latin treatment (tiny letter-spaced uppercase directly beneath monumental Arabic) — sharpens Khuyūt's Arabic-first hierarchy into true wayfinding signage.
From MALACHITE MAJLIS: the scroll-driven single gold-glint on the price chip as it crosses viewport center — one-glint-per-viewport restraint, recolored to Khuyūt's saffron thread.

scores.direction_name: Khuyūt — خيوط (Sadu Threads on Morning Wool)
scores.note: Best appetite engineering in the set: food always on near-white warm ground per Spence, cool hues code-banned within 24px of photos, and the crimson stepped-triangle price chip (white on #A61C2B, 7.5:1) is the most conversion-forward price treatment of all five — plus a dual mode that covers both the 2PM terrace and the 8PM–1AM ordering peak.

Highest demo-theater ceiling but weakest appetite floor: dark grounds suppress appetite and mercilessly expose average food photography, magenta prices read 'nightlife' more than 'edible', and the whole system collapses at a sunlit noon table — an owner demo at 9PM wows, the same demo at lunch loses the sale.

scores.direction_name: PISTACHIO HALA — يا هلا (Sunlit Pistachio & Sour Cherry)
scores.note: The most immediately appetizing on a phone — food on pure warm white with edible pastel plate washes, sour-cherry prices/CTAs hitting the exact Talabat-trained tap reflex, and 4:5 story-frame cards that are free marketing; docked for a pistachio identity that skews 'matcha bar' and reads slightly less premium-unique for an espresso-first cafe charging SAR 26.

Warm, flattering light on food and genuine giga-project premium cues, but its price/CTA layer is the softest in the set (terracotta at ~4.5:1, no chip container) and the whole direction is one timid gradient away from the ubiquitous beige-minimal menu every Riyadh cafe already has — pretty, but least pushy about the money.

scores.direction_name: MALACHITE MAJLIS — Ivory by Day, Emerald by Night
scores.note: Smart discipline (green never touches food, warm item washes) and the national-pride-as-jewelry story lands hard with owners, but emerald as the dominant brand ink keeps a cool, appetite-neutral cast over every viewport, and saffron-bronze #8C5E10 prices are dimmer and less tappable than a true warm-red money color.

judgments.top_pick: Khuyūt — خيوط (Sadu Threads on Morning Wool)
judgments.rationale: Through a menu-engineering lens, Khuyūt is the only direction that maximizes all four criteria simultaneously. Appetite: it is the most rigorously Spence-compliant system — every plate sits on near-white sunlit cream, ambient washes are warm-side-only (madder/saffron/pistachio) at 12-16% saturation so they flatter crema and pastry rather than tint them, and the appetite-hostile indigo is banned near photos as a code-level constant, not a style note. Money prominence: the crimson stepped-triangle price chip is the strongest price treatment in the set (white-on-crimson at 7.5:1, culturally a heritage motif rather than a discount sticker), and the 'سمّ' CTA sits in the exact warm-red register Saudi thumbs are trained to tap by Jahez/HungerStation — while everything around it stays quiet enough that the red still means 'order here'. Premium justification: UNESCO-listed Sadu executed with Swiss restraint reads as unfakeable craft — a SAR 26 latte needs a story, and 'no imported QR template can have this' is precisely that story. Owner demo: the loom weaving itself on scroll, the stitched-thread add-to-order with the knot flying into the tray, and the Layali circular wipe are three distinct wow beats an owner will remember and retell — and the dual mode answers the objection SAHRA can't (noon terrace) and PISTACHIO can't (the 8PM–1AM peak when most orders actually happen). Pistachio Hala is the close second and arguably safer commercially, but it's an aesthetic the market already saturates; Khuyūt sells at the same appetite level while being ownable.
grafts: From SAHRA: the 'توقيع الموسم' Season Signature drop card — one limited-time hero item with a countdown chip and the menu's single permanently-animated keyline (rendered in Khuyūt's crimson thread, not neon). Scarcity mechanics are the highest-ROI upsell device here and Khuyūt currently has no urgency layer.

From PISTACHIO HALA: 4:5 portrait story-frame featured cards (full-bleed photo, Kufi name overlaid, cafe name in the corner) so a screenshot is a ready-made Instagram story — free marketing the owner instantly understands in a demo.

From PISTACHIO HALA: item-level flavor-family plate washes (blush behind desserts, oat behind espresso) layered inside Khuyūt's category washes, tightening the gastrophysics sweetness/red mapping at the individual-card level.

From MALACHITE MAJLIS: the scroll-driven gold-glint light sweep on the price chip as exactly one price crosses viewport center — a compositor-cheap way to pull the eye to the money without breaking the one-crimson-element rule.

From SHUROUQ: the single featured-item 3D tilt card (±6deg pointermove, capped to one card) for the daily signature dish — a tactile hero moment for the demo — plus its discipline of shipping a pre-darkened pressed state so nobody 'brightens up' the accent out of WCAG compliance.

scores.direction_name: Khuyūt — خيوط (Sadu Threads on Morning Wool)
scores.note: Heritage-as-structure is the only direction where the concept, the grid, and the motion are one idea; Sadu is craft, not trend, so it compounds rather than dates — and every signature moment (dashoffset weave, stitched add, shuttle sweep) is compositor-cheap on the existing token system. Only real hazard is the kitsch cliff, and the direction already ships its own guardrails as code-level rules.

Highest short-term wow, worst longevity: neon-on-black is timestamped to this Riyadh Season cycle, is the closest of the five to both the rejected dark template and the emerging QR-vendor 'neon menu' cliche, and the canvas particle confirmation is the priciest moment-per-risk in the whole set.

scores.direction_name: PISTACHIO HALA — يا هلا (Sunlit Pistachio & Sour Cherry)
scores.note: Easiest to execute flawlessly and very screenshot-literate, but it is built on the pistachio/matcha/'delicious pastels 2026' trend trio by its own admission — in 3 years it reads like a dated drink fad, and pastel-matcha-minimal is already the most crowded aesthetic in Gulf cafe branding.

The most elegant engineering of the five (one --zone-h formula drives every wash) and Diriyah-Tan place-branding ages well — but its stated failure mode is real: one timid opacity decision and it collapses into the Riyadh greige-minimal sameness it's trying to transcend, so differentiation rests entirely on execution nerve.

scores.direction_name: MALACHITE MAJLIS — Ivory by Day, Emerald by Night
scores.note: The malachite-vein hero is a genuinely ownable signature and green-as-jewel is a bold reclamation, but the safe corridor is the narrowest here — four distinct drift failure modes (ministry, Starbucks, gold foil, night-mode gravity) plus dual-mode QA make it the highest-supervision build for a solo operator.

judgments.top_pick: Khuyūt — خيوط (Sadu Threads on Morning Wool)
judgments.rationale: Through a craft-and-longevity lens, Khuyūt wins because it is the only direction whose visual language cannot expire or be templated. SAHRA and PISTACHIO are both explicitly pegged to current trend cycles (Boulevard neon, the pistachio wave) — they will look like 2026 in 2029. SHUROUQ ages well but its differentiation depends on gradients being brave enough to escape Riyadh's beige-minimal default, a knife-edge for any implementer. MALACHITE has a strong signature but the tightest execution corridor. Khuyūt's Sadu-as-structure idea is UNESCO-grade permanent, unfakeable by QR-vendor templates (a competitor can copy a gradient; they can't copy a system where the weave IS the divider, the price chip, and the add-to-order interaction), and its signature moments are the cheapest in the set — SVG stroke-dashoffset, scroll-driven timelines, one View Transition — all proven-safe patterns on the existing static, token-based architecture (the palette drops directly onto the current --bg/--card/--ink/--hair token names). Its day-wool default answers the sunlight problem, its Layali mode owns the 8PM–1AM peak, and its acknowledged kitsch risk is governed by enforceable code-level rules (one band per viewport, indigo exclusion radius) rather than taste memos. Highest craft ceiling, longest shelf life, hardest to imitate, lowest technical risk per moment.

From SHUROUQ: the static tiled SVG turbulence grain at ~2.5% opacity over washes, so Khuyūt's 'wool' ground actually reads as fiber/film rather than plastic gradient — a data-URI tile, zero runtime cost.

final.final_concept: Khuyūt swept all three lenses (9/9/9) and ships as day-wool light mode: a sunlit cream ground (#FAF6EE) that photographs food the way ALF and %Arabica photograph themselves, with every ounce of color spent as dyed Sadu threads — one madder-crimson thread (#A61C2B) doing ALL money work (prices, badges, chip glider, add buttons, order CTA) with warm-white text on it, and a deep saffron thread (#8A5A18) as the quiet secondary for line icons, labels and micro-text. From SHUROUQ we graft the single-formula discipline: all 23 item washes keep the existing radial geometry and rotate only a warm ingredient hue (pistachio leaned harder for matcha per PISTACHIO HALA — riding the live drink trend inside the wash system, never as the brand). From SAHRA we graft drop-culture urgency: the existing 'محصول محدود' Limited Harvest reserve block becomes the menu's ONLY permanently-animated element, sealed by a running crimson stitch. From MALACHITE we graft festival restraint sparkle: exactly one price glints saffron as its card crosses viewport center. The loom itself weaves the section dividers on scroll — heritage as structure, not ornament: the woven band IS the divider, the crimson thread IS the price, the stitch IS the add. Indigo/teal is banned entirely, WhatsApp green stays untouched as the one green block users already trust, and the Layali night mode is deferred to a later pass so this one ships with a single, fully-QA'd contrast system.

signature_moments.name: The Loom Weaves Itself (self-weaving Sadu dividers)
signature_moments.spec: Lives on the existing .divider SVG (the DIVIDER template string near line 883: one path with two long strands, a diamond 'ayn' and two short dashes, stroked in currentColor = --hair2 crimson thread). Implementation: no DOM change beyond the template. CSS, gated inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference): .divider path{stroke-dasharray:260;stroke-dashoffset:260;transition:stroke-dashoffset .9s var(--ease) .1s} html[lang="ar"] .divider path{stroke-dashoffset:-260} .divider.woven path{stroke-dashoffset:0}. (Use raw px dasharray 260 ≈ total path length, NOT pathLength=1 — subpath dash normalization is inconsistent across engines.) JS (~6 lines, alongside the existing RISE IntersectionObserver): new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(en=>{if(en.isIntersecting){en.target.classList.add('woven');io.unobserve(en.target)}}),{threshold:.5}) observing every .divider — each band threads itself once, in reading direction (LTR in EN, RTL in AR via the negative offset). Reduced-motion fallback: all rules live inside the no-preference block, so the divider renders pre-woven with zero animation. Cost: one-time stroke paint per section, compositor-cheap.

signature_moments.name: The Stitched Seal — توقيع الموسم on the Limited Harvest card
signature_moments.spec: SAHRA's drop-culture graft, hosted by the EXISTING .reserve block ('محصول محدود / Only 6 cups daily', built near line 911) — it becomes the menu's ONLY permanently-animated element. DOM: when building the reserve HTML, append one overlay SVG as first child of .reserve (which gets position:relative): <svg class="stitch" aria-hidden="true" style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none"><rect x="1.5" y="1.5" rx="18" fill="none" stroke="var(--gold)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7 6" stroke-linecap="round" style="width:calc(100% - 3px);height:calc(100% - 3px)"/></svg>, and change .reserve's own border-color to transparent so the running stitch replaces the solid keyline. Animation, gated in @media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference): .stitch rect{animation:stitch 1.8s linear infinite} @keyframes stitch{to{stroke-dashoffset:-26}} (offset -26 = 2x the 13px dash period, seamless loop); html[lang="ar"] .stitch rect{animation-direction:reverse}. Reduced-motion fallback: a static dashed crimson seal (animation never applies). Cost: one tiny stroke repaint region; no box-shadow, no filter. Rule: this is the single permanently-moving crimson element in the whole menu.

signature_moments.name: Saffron Glint on the Price
signature_moments.spec: MALACHITE's graft: exactly one price glints as its card crosses viewport center. CSS, gated in @media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference): .price.glint{background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--gold2) 40%,#E2A84B 50%,var(--gold2) 60%) 120% 0/250% 100% no-repeat;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:glint .9s var(--ease) both} @keyframes glint{to{background-position:-20% 0}} html[lang="ar"] .price.glint{animation-name:glintR} @keyframes glintR{from{background-position:-20% 0}to{background-position:120% 0}} plus .price.glint s{background:none;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--muted)} so the struck-through old price stays muted. JS (~12 lines): if(matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)').matches){var gio=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(en=>{if(!en.isIntersecting)return;var p=en.target.querySelector('.price');if(p&&!p.dataset.glinted){document.querySelectorAll('.price.glint').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('glint'));p.dataset.glinted=1;p.classList.add('glint');p.addEventListener('animationend',()=>p.classList.remove('glint'),{once:true})}}),{rootMargin:'-42% 0px -42% 0px'});document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(c=>gio.observe(c));} — single active glint enforced, once per card per page load. Reduced-motion fallback: no glint, prices render in flat var(--gold2). Background-position tween on one small text node — negligible repaint.

implementation_steps: STEP 1 — Swap the 13 schema tokens in :root (line 36-44) to the css_tokens values exactly. The comment 'Majlis at night' becomes 'Khuyūt — Sadu threads on morning wool'.

STEP 2 — ON-ACCENT (non-negotiable, accent is dark): --on-accent changes from #1D1712 to #FFF6EC (warm wool-white, 6.96:1 on #A61C2B). This carries the text of every .badge, .chip.on (glider chips), .addb, .ob-count, .ob-cta, .opt.on and .sheet-add. Manually check: .badge.soft (UNESCO) over the qahwa/yemen washes — if it dips below 4.5:1 in the screenshot, add color:var(--gold) to .badge.soft; glider chip text in both languages; toast over hero; scrim + sheet stack; watermark subtlety at 80% brightness on OLED (banding check on the washes).
do_not: Do NOT let crimson exceed one element per viewport: it is money/action only (prices, badges, glider, add buttons, order CTA, the reserve stitch). Never crimson headers, body text, backgrounds or icon strokes — one leak and the menu reads Jahez-red commodity.
Do NOT introduce indigo/teal anywhere, and never any cool hue within 24px of an item art area — the coolest permitted hue in the build is the desaturated rain/mint sage already specified.
Do NOT use Sadu bands as repeating background fills, add a second woven divider per viewport, or add any pattern borders — one band, one crimson element, per screen. Kitsch is the kill-radius.
Do NOT brighten #A61C2B 'for pop' or lighten pressed states — contrast fails; pressed state darkens to #8E1624.
Do NOT keep --on-accent #1D1712 — dark-on-crimson is illegible; it must ship as #FFF6EC.
Do NOT recolor the WhatsApp button (#22A55A stays) and do not use --green for anything except progress/success states.
Do NOT ship the Layali night mode in this pass — day-wool is the identity; night is a future toggle with its own re-derived contrast pass, not an alpha-fade of these tokens.

Do NOT animate box-shadows, filters or gradients by repaint — motion is restricted to stroke-dashoffset, background-position, transform, opacity, and class toggles, all gated behind prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference.
Do NOT letter-space Arabic or change the type system — the fonts, sizes and layout are fixed; drama comes from the thread colors and the three moments only.
Do NOT raise the kufic watermark above rgba(166,28,43,.05) or the washes above the specified alphas — the ground must always read as sun-warmed wool, never poster color.
